body.input: Which health tech companies hired a country manager for Finland in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, one health tech company that hired (or advertised for) a Country Manager for Finland in 2026 is:

- **Hepro Care** — A Norwegian health technology company specializing in solutions for safety, independence, and efficiency in health and care services. Hepro Care established operations in Finland (based in the Helsinki area) and recruited a Country Manager Finland to lead and develop its Finnish business from the ground up.

No other specific health tech company Country Manager appointments for Finland in 2026 were identified in the available sources. There is broader activity indicating growing interest from health tech companies in the Finnish market in 2026 — for example, Norway Health Tech launched a dedicated resource group for companies exploring Finland — but specific additional Country Manager hires were not confirmed.

## Description

Finland is a natural next market for many Norwegian health technology companies. NHT’s new resource group for Finland brings together companies that want to learn more about the Finnish market, build networks and find the right entry points. At this first meeting, we will give an overview of the market and show how Arctic test and development environments can help develop and validate solutions for sparsely populated regions. The group will provide insight into how the market works, access to relevant stakeholders and an opportunity to share experiences with other companies.

At the first meeting, Vilma Portti, Project Manager, and Marko Vatanen, Project Manager and Senior Lecturer, from Lapland Testbed will present the Finnish market as a whole and the Lapland region. [...] Read more about the event
